_why: Frozen recurrence-matching fixture. QI: qi-threshold-calibration-consumes-its-own-datum. Three times in one session a threshold was set just under the live corpus maximum by the same commit that repaired the pair producing that maximum: _PREFIX_FLOOR=30 (ceiling 18) -> _MIN_OVERLAP=0.50 (ceiling 0.429) -> _MIN_OVERLAP=0.40 (ceiling 0.375). Each was measured honestly and each was unreachable on arrival. A threshold on a self-remediating corpus must be calibrated against FROZEN labelled pairs, not a live sweep. 2026-08-05 (QI-34): the fourth change is NOT a fourth tuning — the matcher switched from the node's truncated `label` (heading[:50]) to its `name` (heading[:200]), which was already emitted alongside it, and now excludes open findings whose heading is a RESOLUTION NOTICE (those were the corpus's top three scores and all three were a closure matched against its own '**RESOLVED**' restatement). Corpus max 0.375 -> 0.267; a realistic restatement 0.500 -> 0.900; separation 1.33x -> 3.37x; _MIN_OVERLAP 0.40 -> 0.45 chosen inside the resulting empty band rather than from the live maximum. THESE THREE PAIRS ARE STILL NOT SEPARATED (0.188 / 0.000 / 0.071) — they are heavy rewordings and the change does not claim to reach them.
